summary.oneLiner: Siemens Energy India is uniquely positioned as the only pure-play, end-to-end energy infrastructure player in India, benefiting from the country's $1T+ energy transformation plan — doubling power capacity to 1,000 GW by 2030, requiring massive transmission build-out, grid stabilization, and industrial electrification. With a 162B INR order book and 49% order growth, it is executing on structural tailwinds while expanding its global manufacturing hub role.

one-line thesis: Siemens Energy India is uniquely positioned as the only pure-play, end-to-end energy infrastructure player in India, benefiting from the country's $1T+ energy transformation plan — doubling power capacity to 1,000 GW by 2030, requiring massive transmission build-out, grid stabilization, and industrial electrification. With a 162B INR order book and 49% order growth, it is executing on structural tailwinds while expanding its global manufacturing hub role.
financial scorecard: Revenue: +25% YoY (78B INR); EBITDA: 19.3% (18% ex-one-time); PAT: Not disclosed; Order Book: +49% YoY to 162B INR; Net Debt: Not disclosed
guidance: No explicit forward guidance provided; however, management emphasized 162B INR order book secures multi-year revenue visibility and expects sustained double-digit growth in orders and revenue driven by transmission and generation demand.
order book & pipeline: 162B INR (as of FY25 end), up 49% YoY; 64% from transmission (84B INR), 36% from generation (47B INR); Q4 orders at 23.5B INR, with large-ticket wins in STATCOM and HVDC.
segment / subsidiary detail: Transmission: 64% of order book (84B INR), 54% of revenue (42B INR), 19.3% EBITDA; Generation: 36% of order book (47B INR), 46% of revenue (36B INR), 18% EBITDA (ex-one-time); Services: 25.6% of revenue; Product vs Project: Product 32%, Project 42% (down 5pp YoY); Exports: 3% of revenue, up 300 bps YoY.
growth verticals / optionality: Green hydrogen (PEM electrolyzers), data center captive power (gas turbines), E-ferry electrification, nuclear energy supply chain participation, and industrial automation/digitalization solutions; all are strategic adjacencies with early-stage customer engagement.
margins & cost dynamics: EBITDA margin expanded from 15.7% (FY24) to 19.3% (FY25) on operational efficiency, product mix shift toward higher-margin transmission, and cost discipline; Q4 EBITDA margin was 16.9% (ex-280 bps one-time impact).
capex / expansion: Expanding Kalwa transformer factory (doubling capacity); expanding Vadodara steam turbine plant (now at 2,000 turbines delivered); no explicit capex figure disclosed, but investments are tied to order backlog execution and localization goals.
capital allocation: Prioritizing reinvestment in manufacturing capacity, R&D (1,500 engineers in India), and workforce upskilling; no dividends or buybacks mentioned; focus on organic growth and global supply chain integration.
risks & watch-items: Delayed policy implementation (e.g., nuclear reforms), supply chain bottlenecks for critical components, currency volatility impacting import costs, grid congestion delays, and competition from domestic players in transmission equipment.
management quality / tone: Highly confident, visionary, and execution-focused; management emphasized India’s structural energy demand, operational excellence, and global manufacturing leadership; tone was upbeat, data-driven, and aligned with national development goals.
non-obvious takeaways: Siemens Energy India is not just a local player — it is a critical node in Siemens Energy AG’s global manufacturing network, supplying components and engineering to global projects (e.g., turbines, switchgear parts), making it a hidden export engine with high-margin engineering services.

themes.title: Power transmission & renewable-evacuation capex
themes.need: Grid build-out to evacuate ~90 GW of new renewables is the broadest theme in the universe - pulling EHV/765kV transmission EPC, towers, conductors, OPGW, cables and HVDC. POWERGRID/ADANIENSOL TBCB pipeline plus state RDSS/underground-cabling capex (Rajesh Power 544291, OMPOWER) underpins multi-year visibility for EPC, tower (KP Green 544150, SKIPPER) and conductor/cable makers (KEI, RRKABEL, DYCL).
themes.driver: Fresh TBCB awards + execution ramp; EPC order inflows over next 1-2 quarters.
